figurative_meaning_en: To give up hope of attaining or achieving something
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে প্রকল্পটির সঙ্গে হাত ধুয়ে বসল।
চাকরির আশায় হাত ধুয়ে বসার পর সে অন্য পথ খুঁজতে শুরু করল।
example_sentences_in_english: He washed his hands of the project after repeated failures.
After giving up hope on the job, she started looking for other opportunities.
note: This idiom metaphorically implies finality in abandoning efforts, akin to cleaning up after a task and settling down without further pursuit.
